info.title: ResearchAgent local HTTP API
info.description: Local operator engine, fixture or XRPL Testnet only. No real value. Supported developer routes are detailed; x-internal routes are UI/owner inventory, not a public integration promise. Use the printed engine URL, never the UI port. Bearer credentials must stay private. All mode labels must remain visible.

port.description: Example OFFSET=1300 source API port; zero-clone app prints an ephemeral engine port.

200.description: Existing run for the same stable identity

201.description: Admitted once; may still be active

post.description: One admission per stable idempotency_key. Same question/key returns original run even if requested budget changes. Different question with same key is refused. Keep the key on uncertainty; poll runId or SSE, never blindly create another intent. Only deterministic policy can buy. Budgets round down to 5 cents, maximum S$5, further limited by caps. Default active work limit 4; overload returns 503, no queue.

parameters.description: x402 v2 signed payment payload for the exact quote; same stable key on retry.

post.description: Optional Testnet x402 hire service. Fixed fee S$0.20 plus research budget. Returns moneyChain for inbound payment, purchases, royalties and caller change. Requires caller signing authority and enabled operator hire configuration. Native XRP exact interop with pinned x402-xrpl 0.3.4 is tested with a synthetic ledger; escrow/TEST-SGD extensions are not generic Starter Kit compatibility. Not A2A.

get.summary: Public writer catalogue with sales and trust from the caller's retained history only
get.description: Read-only. Hosted mode requires a visitor session and excludes foreign or expired runs. Returns article titles/prices, authorship, verified credentials where available, confirmed Testnet finish hashes and refunds, and observed trust samples. Never returns premium passages, raw intents, questions, payment keys or owner data.

200.description: Writer catalogue and caller-scoped recorded Testnet activity.

get.summary: Whether a finished decline can be shared as a proof of refusal, and the proof if it was
get.description: Owner route (hosted: the visitor's own runs only; a foreign id is 404). Returns eligible, a plain-English reason when not, and the proof path once shared. Reads only; nothing is published.

200.description: { eligible, code?, message?, proof?: { id, path, createdAt } }

post.summary: Publish the sanitized, immutable proof of refusal for a finished, anchored, no-purchase run
post.description: Explicit share. One proof per run: a second call returns the first. 409 with a code (not_finished, purchased, answered, simulated, anchor_pending, anchor_missing, private_question, too_large, verification_failed) when the run cannot be shared; 429 proof_limit when the session's daily shares are used.

200.description: The proof already exists for this run.

201.description: The proof was created. Body: { proof: { id, path, createdAt } }.

409.description: Not shareable. Body: { error: code, message }.

429.description: Daily share limit reached for this session.

get.summary: Public proof-of-refusal page (HTML) with link-preview metadata
get.description: Read-only and unauthenticated, by the sharer's choice. Shows the question the sharer published, what was found, S$0.00 spent, the anchored XRPL Testnet transaction and the verification result. Never returns premium text. Hosted: no session is created; reads are limited per address.

200.description: HTML page.

get.summary: The proof's receipts bundle, verifiable with the open-source verifier
get.description: Same shape as /runs/{id}/receipts.json, sanitized: no payments, grants or paid text. Public and read-only.

200.description: Receipts bundle (JSON).

get.summary: Self-contained proof card (HTML download, no scripts or network)
get.description: The same facts as the page with the receipts embedded for saving. Public and read-only.

200.description: HTML attachment.
